bullets.text: Mapped the merchant onboarding process end to end and removed three duplicate document checks, cutting onboarding from nine to six working days.
Analysed 18 months of support tickets in SQL and showed 41% concerned payout delays, which became the next quarter's top priority.
Wrote requirement documents for four merchant dashboard features, each with acceptance criteria the engineering team built and tested against.
Ran weekly metrics reviews with the operations lead from a shared tracker, flagging onboarding cases stuck for more than three days.
Rebuilt the paper book-lending register as a shared sheet covering 12 village libraries and about 2,400 books, so lost books became traceable.
Coordinated a donation drive across three colleges that collected 850 books for the libraries with the thinnest shelves.
Surveyed 312 consumers for a D2C snack brand unsure how to price a new product line against established supermarket brands.
Applied Van Westendorp price-sensitivity analysis to recommend a Rs 40 to 45 price band, and presented the findings to the founders.
